name: Tilt-Shift
desc: A swung lens laid across the frame — one plane stays sharp while everything in front and behind falls away into defocus, aerial haze lifting the far ground and a warm cast sinking the near one, patchy air drifting through the soft zones and every stray highlight opening into a rimmed bokeh disc.

energy.doc: grade + haze amplitude and bokeh bloom strength

blur.doc: how far out of focus the off-plane zones go

spread.doc: width of the sharp band and softness of its falloff

density.doc: count of drifting haze cells and bokeh discs

scale.doc: bokeh disc and haze cell size

hue.doc: haze / far-ground hue (the near cast takes its complement)

x.doc: focus plane anchor when axis is vertical

y.doc: focus plane anchor when axis is horizontal

style.doc: aesthetic: toy-town split of cool far haze against a warm sunk near ground / restrained neutral cinema defocus / soft-focus reverie blurred everywhere with a pale bloom / abstract false-colour depth chart that re-reads the frame as a z-map

act.doc: multi-minute program: wander lets the focus plane roam / rack pulls focus in long deliberate excursions / breathe holds the plane and pumps the band width on the swell
